detector_input.geometry: RGB LetterBox auto=False, pad114, bilinear OpenCV resize

features.crop_integer: floor left/top, ceil right/bottom, clipped to image

bank.shots: 10 fixed normal training files/groups/GT objects per reference; one preselected object per file
bank.support_geometry: GT-anchored for ALL arms: R0/R1 GT crop; R2 GT ROI from full-image forward
bank.coreset: official anomalib KCenterGreedy ratio0.1 seed7001; independently seeded per path/ref
bank.R0_R1: identical support feature path; verified shared bank, no old bank reused

query.R0: GT native crop -> Resize320 -> original COCO prefix0..4
query.R1: new detector -> native predicted crop -> Resize320 -> extra COCO prefix0..4
query.R2: same new detector and same predictions -> same-forward P3 -> RoIAlign

scoring.distance: exact FP32 Euclidean on channel-normalized patches, official PatchCore distance

matching.rule: confidence-descending greedy one-to-one whole-insulator GT matching
matching.unmatched: unassigned prediction; scored and counted as FP, never assigned fault label
matching.no_box: unlocalized; no fallback, no anomaly score; missed GT stay in coverage denominator

evaluation.conditional: R1/R2 AUROC over identical matched GT objects; R0 also reported on same subset
evaluation.interpretation: coverage is localization recall, not thresholded fault-diagnosis recall

timing.reference: ref3001 banks only, fixed representative; all queries and boxes
timing.throughput: sequential frame_batch1 throughput only; no larger-frame-batch claim
timing.profiling: one separate all-frame stage-profile pass, not added to independent end-to-end timing

limits: CPLID defects synthetic; unknown shared source ancestry; R0 is a reference, not guaranteed upper bound
